meta.title: Client Engagement Health Check
meta.description: See how much of the Client Engagement Suite you're actually using, and what to switch on next.

intro.headline: Client Engagement Health Check
intro.subheadline: See how much of CES you're actually using
intro.body: The Client Engagement Suite includes far more than most teams turn on. This 2-minute check looks at how you handle everyday client workflows today, scores how much of CES you're leveraging, and shows you, feature by feature, what you're missing out on and how to switch it on.

questions.text: First, which platform are you on?

options.label: CareLogic
Credible

questions.text: How do you confirm a text, email, or voice reminder actually reached a client?

options.label: We can see delivery status, failures, and client replies in one place
We check manually, or only find out when a client no-shows
We have no real visibility once a reminder is sent

questions.text: When you need to get an announcement, closure, or urgent alert to all clients at once, how do you do it?

options.label: We send one message to all clients through the portal (text/email/voice)
We do it manually in batches, or only reach some clients
Staff make individual calls or send messages one at a time

questions.text: How do clients register for the portal and start getting appointment reminders and form notifications?

options.label: They can register with their phone number and get reminders/notifications by text
Registration is email-only, but we text some clients separately
Registration and notifications rely on email, so we can't reach clients without it

questions.text: How do clients complete intake and required forms before their first visit?

options.label: Digitally through the portal — assigned and tracked by us
A mix of digital and paper, depending on the form
Mostly paper, or in-office on the day of the visit

questions.text: How do clients and staff sign required documents?

options.label: Digitally inside the system, captured right in the clinical record
With a third-party e-sign tool, then uploaded back in
On paper — or signatures are often collected late or missing

questions.text: When a client updates their demographic info, how does it get into the EHR?

options.label: It flows from the portal into structured EHR fields for review
Staff re-key it manually from what the client provides
We collect it on paper and clean it up later

questions.text: Can your clients view their own health record details (meds, allergies, providers) themselves?

options.label: Yes — they have secure, read-only access in the portal
Only if they call or request records from staff
No — staff field every request for record details

questions.text: How do clients get a shareable copy of their clinical data (e.g., a CCDA summary of care)?

options.label: They request and view a structured export right in the portal
We generate and send files manually when asked
We fax, email PDFs, or handle it ad hoc

questions.text: How do clients submit privacy or data-sharing restriction requests?

options.label: Through a structured request in the portal, routed to us for review
Informally by phone, email, or paperwork
We don't have a consistent way to capture these

questions.text: How do you confirm a telehealth session actually happened and how long it lasted?

options.label: We have session-level logs (join/exit/wait times) we can export
We rely on provider notes or manual follow-up
We have no reliable record once the visit is over

questions.text: How do clients see their balance and pay it?

options.label: Directly in the portal — balances sync and they pay online
Through a separate billing portal or mailed statements
They call, mail checks, or pay in person

products.name: eSignatures
products.whatItDoes: eSignatures let clients and staff sign required treatment plans and service documents digitally within the portal. Unlike third-party tools that generate standalone PDFs, signature data is captured directly in the system — including who signed, when, and which form was completed.
products.whyItMatters: When signatures are collected outside the system, documentation can be delayed, misplaced, or uploaded incorrectly — creating compliance gaps and billing risk.
benefits: Capture signatures directly in the clinical record
Prevent billing delays and denied claims caused by missing or late signatures
Reduce compliance and audit risk with clear, timestamped signature records
Eliminate manual uploads and rework tied to external signature tools
Give clients an easy, familiar way to sign documents online

products.name: Forms & Intake Workflows
products.whatItDoes: Digital Forms and Intake Workflows can be assigned in the EHR and completed by the client in the portal. Clients complete modern, mobile-friendly forms designed for clarity and ease of use.
products.whyItMatters: Abandoned intake paperwork slows down care, creates rework for staff, and often leads to rescheduled appointments. Replace paper forms and hard-to-use EHR layouts with a guided, client-friendly experience that improves completion rates and reduces delays.
benefits: Get clients fully prepared before their first visit with guided forms
Ensure intake forms are completed before visits, reducing last-minute delays
Improve completion rates with modern, easy-to-use digital forms
Reduce staff follow-up and manual data entry tied to missing paperwork
Create a smoother onboarding experience for new and returning clients

products.name: Notification Analytics
products.whatItDoes: Notification Analytics gives your team visibility into the SMS, email, and voice notifications sent to clients. You can view delivery status, failure reasons, timestamps, and client replies — all in one place — without submitting a support case.
products.whyItMatters: It lets you determine with certainty whether a notification actually reached a client, or whether intervention is needed (e.g., incorrect email, full inbox, marked as spam).
benefits: See exactly what happened to every appointment reminder
Identify failed or undelivered reminders in seconds
Understand why a message didn't go through
Troubleshoot missed appointments with confidence
Reduce reliance on support for basic notification questions

products.name: Client Billing Module
products.whatItDoes: Clients view their balance and make payments directly in the portal. Balances sync from the statement batch process, giving clients one clear place to see what they owe and pay — without separate logins or paper statements.
products.whyItMatters: When billing lives outside the portal, clients miss payments or get confused, and staff are left following up. Bringing billing into the portal reduces friction for clients and cuts down on manual follow-up for staff.
benefits: Make it easy for clients to understand and pay their balance in the portal
Position billing as client convenience and staff relief, not finance complexity
Replace disconnected billing portals or mailed statements
Fits naturally after Forms + eSignatures (complete → sign → bill)
Reinforce the portal as the single destination for the client experience

products.name: Demographic Data Mapping
products.whatItDoes: Clients enter and update demographic information directly through the portal. Select fields from portal forms are mapped to structured EHR fields, so data can be reviewed and accepted before syncing.
products.whyItMatters: Manual data entry creates inefficiencies, inconsistencies, and avoidable clean-up work. Small variations in how data is entered can impact reporting, billing, and even create duplicate records. This feature helps you capture cleaner data from the start.
benefits: Streamline intake by sending demographic data straight to the EHR
Reduce manual data entry and clean-up by capturing demographics digitally
Improve data accuracy and consistency across client records
Support cleaner reporting and billing with structured, standardized data
Save staff time previously spent correcting or re-entering information

products.name: Broadcast Messaging
products.whatItDoes: Broadcast Messaging lets staff send a single message to all clients at once through the portal using text, email, or voice. It's designed for announcements, marketing, service updates, policy changes, reminders, or urgent alerts.
products.whyItMatters: When important updates need to go out quickly, manual calls and emails are time-consuming and inconsistent. Broadcast Messaging gives you a reliable way to communicate broadly and instantly.
benefits: Reach all clients at once without hours of manual outreach
Send urgent alerts and updates quickly during closures or changes
Eliminate hours of manual calls and emails
Improve consistency of communication across your client population
Keep clients informed and prepared, reducing confusion and missed appointments

products.name: Telehealth Analytics
products.whatItDoes: Session-level logs for telehealth appointments — showing when providers and clients joined and exited, how long they waited, and whether the session occurred. Data can be exported via CSV for audits, supervision, or internal tracking.
products.whyItMatters: Without session data, teams rely on memory or manual follow-ups to confirm whether a telehealth appointment happened. Telehealth Analytics gives clinical, operational, and compliance teams a reliable source of truth.
benefits: Clear visibility into every virtual visit
Verify session attendance for audits, compliance, or supervision
Confirm timing and duration of telehealth visits without back-and-forth
Reduce administrative follow-ups when appointments are missed or disputed
Support accountability and QA with objective, timestamped data

products.name: Client Personal Records
products.whatItDoes: Client Personal Records gives clients secure, read-only access to key information from their health record directly in the portal — demographics, medications, allergies, providers, and other personal health information — without needing to request records or contact staff.
products.whyItMatters: When clients don't have visibility into their own records, staff spend time answering basic questions or fulfilling record requests. Client Personal Records increases transparency while reducing administrative follow-up.
benefits: Give clients secure, self-service access to their key health information
Reduce phone calls and messages asking for basic record details
Improve transparency and trust by sharing information clients expect to see

products.name: Request Data Export (CCDA)
products.whatItDoes: Health records can be securely shared and viewed directly in the portal. Instead of downloading raw CCDA files, information is presented in clear, readable sections — like medications, diagnoses, and care plans — making it easier for staff and clients to understand and use.
products.whyItMatters: When client data lives in silos, care teams are forced to rely on PDFs, faxes, or incomplete records. CCDA integration helps you share critical information across providers without delays, rework, or manual handoffs.
benefits: Structured health records that move with the client
Improve continuity of care when clients transition between providers or programs
Reduce manual record sharing like faxing or emailing PDFs
Support care coordination and compliance with standards-based data exchange
Give clients access to their own health records in a clear, usable format

products.name: Request for Restriction
products.whatItDoes: Request for Restriction lets clients submit privacy restriction requests directly through the portal. Requests are routed to your organization for review and handling, helping teams manage client preferences around data sharing with payers, family members, or other third parties in a structured way.
products.whyItMatters: Without a self-service option, restriction requests are often handled informally through phone calls, emails, or paperwork — making them easy to miss or inconsistently tracked. This feature centralizes requests in one place and supports a more reliable, compliant process.
benefits: Let clients control how their health information is shared
Centralize restriction requests instead of ad-hoc, manual processes
Support a more reliable, consistent, and compliant workflow
Signal compliance alignment without deep HIPAA or ONC complexity
Fits naturally alongside CCDA and Analytics as part of trust + transparency

products.name: Phone Number-Based Registration
products.whatItDoes: Phone Number Registration lets clients use their phone number to register their portal account and receive appointment reminders and form notifications. Instead of relying on email, clients can sign up and stay connected via their phone number.
products.whyItMatters: When account registration and notifications depend on email alone, clients without reliable email access are hard to reach — leading to missed reminders and incomplete sign-ups. Phone-based registration meets clients where they are and improves the odds that reminders and notifications actually land.
benefits: Let clients register using the contact method they use most
Reach clients who don't reliably check or use email
Deliver appointment reminders and form notifications by text
Reduce missed appointments tied to unseen email reminders
Simplify account setup to improve portal adoption
